item.title: Walkabout Mini Golf Studio Mighty Coconut Course Corrects With Layoffs, $1 More For Future DLC
item.description: Walkabout Mini Golf laid off some workers and announced a price increase for future DLC.

item.title: Attending Lakers Games In Apple Immersive Plays To VR's Strengths
item.description: The Lakers in Apple Immersive points to the future of broadcasting.

item.title: Quest's New 'Navigator' UI Becoming Default As Horizon Feed To Be Removed
item.description: "Starting" in Quest v85, the new 'Navigator' UI is becoming the default, and the Horizon Feed will be "gradually" removed from Horizon OS.

item.title: Lynx-R2 Has 126° Field Of View Via Aspheric Pancake Lenses
item.description: Lynx-R2, coming "this summer", is set to have the widest field of view of any standalone headset to date.

item.title: The Magician VR Is A New Fantasy Appearing On Quest Soon
item.description: The Magician VR: The Cursed Wand is an upcoming fantasy VR action-adventure for Quest available to wishlist now.

item.title: Half-Life: Alyx Soundtrack Getting CD and Vinyl Release
item.description: The Half-Life: Alyx soundtrack is releasing on vinyl and CD in April, with pre-orders live now, along with heavy discounts on the game and its digital soundtrack.

item.title: Meta CFO: We're “Building Future Headsets” & Still “Have Optimism” In VR
item.description: Meta CFO Susan Li says the company still has "optimism in the future of VR", and confirmed that it's still "building future headsets".

item.title: Thief VR: Legacy of Shadow Refines Gameplay Mechanics In Latest Update
item.description: Thief VR: Legacy of Shadow launched its 4.0 update, focused on refining the gameplay experience for an overall smoother feel.

item.title: D-Day VR Museum On Steam Is An Entertaining Educational Exhibition
item.description: D-Day VR Museum is a PC VR exhibition of one of the most pivotal moments in history, using every audiovisual tool to keep the education engaging.

item.title: Quest 3 v85 PTC Can Turn Any Surface Into A Virtual Keyboard
item.description: With Horizon OS v85 PTC, Quest 3 can turn any surface into a virtual keyboard, and Meta says you can remap the Quest 3S action button.
